clips.title: FlashAttention Pays a Two-Year Ecosystem Tax
clips.summary: FlashAttention proved itself early, but it still took roughly 20 months for the ecosystem to catch up. Kernel wins are real, but infrastructure moves slower than papers.
clips.hook: Great math still waits on infrastructure

clips.title: Mixture of Experts Is a Capital Hammer
clips.summary: Mixture of Experts looked elegant on paper, but adoption waited until labs were willing to pay the systems cost of routing, parallelism, and server rewrites.
clips.hook: MoE spread only when labs could afford the pain

clips.title: Hardware Friction Becomes a Startup Tax
clips.summary: The same hardware friction that acts like a moat for major labs becomes runway burn for startups. Transformer dominance is partly an economic trap set by silicon.
clips.hook: Silicon creates one market for giants and another for startups
